name: tpl-chain-response-1-nogoal-carry~p1
task: Should the box fall, make your very next move the one that picks it back up. If you get to the exit, you must have the box in your hands.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task requires the agent to reach the exit ('If you get to the exit...'), which makes the exit a goal. However, the candidate treats 'at_exit' only as a condition for a rule (Response). This results in a rule-only task with no hard goal and an empty FINAL_STATES. Add a hard Existence(at_exit) to make reaching the exit a requirement.
